description: 1.5.0: one part of a source upload. The body is the part's raw bytes (not JSON) -- here the 3-byte string 'abc', which the replay harness sends literally (see setup.note). A part may be re-sent before complete; the later copy wins.

setup.note: request body is the raw bytes b'abc' (3 bytes, application/octet-stream); the contract replay sends exactly those bytes
